plotting_plan.title: AIRTOS Architecture and Evidence Flow
plotting_plan.objective: PaperBanana-generated, icon-rich, flat-color systems diagram showing qualified plan production, the joint admission gate, heterogeneous governed execution, bounded recovery, and non-self-certifying trace feedback without gradients or shadows.

plotting_plan.title: Admission Correctness and Atomic Publication
plotting_plan.objective: Three-panel double-column plot using a stacked error bar chart, horizontal log-scale endpoint bars, and a horizontal stacked transaction bar to show admission correctness and 400,000 generation-checked concurrent publications.

plotting_plan.title: Memory Isolation and Physical Data Coherency
plotting_plan.objective: Three-panel double-column plot using a stacked lease-outcome bar, a log-scaled DMA latency line chart, and horizontal percentage bars for complete-path correctness and omission-control detection.

plotting_plan.title: Recovery Closure, Trace Quality, and Short HIL
plotting_plan.objective: Four-panel double-column plot using horizontal log-scale endpoint bars, trace-metric bars, reopen-latency bars, and a temperature range plot for scoped short-HIL lifecycle evidence without pooling denominators.

plotting_plan.title: Timing-Evidence Applicability
plotting_plan.objective: Three-panel double-column plot using a WCET-sensitivity line chart, grouped board-timing bars, and a horizontal lollipop chart for the seven-operation control-path p99 audit.

introduction_strategy.hook_hypothesis: Edge inference increasingly couples compiler-generated execution plans to heterogeneous resources whose timing, memory, coherency, and recovery states are visible only at runtime.
introduction_strategy.problem_gap_hypothesis: Existing real-time scheduling, heterogeneous task runtimes, NPU multi-tenancy, and runtime assurance do not jointly bind compiler evidence and applicability to atomic memory-time admission and stale-event-safe recovery; the claim is restricted to the tested finite domain and single K230 board.
search_directions: Foundational EDF and sporadic-task feasibility work establishing the assumptions behind deadline claims
Surveys and systems on heterogeneous DAG runtimes and accelerator operating-system abstractions
Edge-AI and NPU multi-tenant scheduling systems emphasizing latency, QoS, memory, and isolation
Runtime assurance and Simplex-style work separating high-performance execution from safety decisions
DMA ownership and cache-coherency specifications relevant to non-coherent edge accelerators

related_work_strategy.overview: Separate scheduling theory, heterogeneous runtimes, accelerator sharing, and runtime assurance to position AIRTOS as a governance layer rather than a new EDF or generic RTOS.

subsections.methodology_cluster: EDF feasibility analysis and heterogeneous task-graph scheduling
subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Review work published before 2026-07-05 on EDF assumptions, processor-demand analysis, typed heterogeneous DAGs, and per-resource non-preemptive scheduling.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: Task and DAG schedulers generally assume jobs and execution bounds are already trusted and do not bind compiler evidence, leases, coherency, and recovery into admission.
limitation_search_queries: heterogeneous real-time DAG scheduling WCET non-preemptive accelerator
EDF admission control running residual blocking sporadic reservation
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: AIRTOS retains per-resource EDF as a mechanism but places it inside a broader evidence-constrained admission transaction.

subsections.methodology_cluster: OS accelerator abstractions, task runtimes, and NPU/GPU multi-tenancy
subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Review work published before 2026-07-05 on PTask, StarPU, Legion, PREMA, Planaria, MoCA, DREAM, Clockwork, and related resource-sharing systems.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: These systems optimize scheduling, utilization, or QoS but do not expose a consumer-checkable plan-evidence predicate coupled to memory-time atomicity and recovery generations.
limitation_search_queries: NPU multi tenancy scheduling recovery stale completion event
accelerator runtime memory sharing QoS admission control edge AI
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: AIRTOS treats an evidence-carrying plan, rather than an opaque kernel request, as the admitted runtime object.

subsections.methodology_cluster: Runtime assurance, safe fallback, DMA ownership, and fault recovery
subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Review work and official specifications published before 2026-07-05 on Simplex/runtime assurance, DMA fences, cache ownership, and RTOS deadline APIs.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: Safety filters and DMA specifications define important mechanisms but do not jointly attribute late completions by epoch and cookie or require fallback plans to pass the full original gate.
limitation_search_queries: runtime assurance Simplex fallback revalidation real-time systems
DMA cache ownership stale interrupt reset generation cookie
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: AIRTOS combines explicit plan-driven ownership transitions with generation-scoped completion and bounded, re-admitted recovery.
